input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the volume of air served by scrubber-1-t4, as V = Qe * tau from a raise-then-decay CO2 curve with the two Lab occupants as the source.

monitoring.reason: The two Lab occupants breathe the raised CO2; the Hab-B crew are outside the volume under test and their air is not raised.

steps.why: Rise: reduced scrubber flow (Qe about 0.4 m3/min) moves the equilibrium up to about 1900 ppm; from 900 ppm the Lab should climb roughly 300 ppm, well above sensor noise, well under the limits. Hatch held closed.
Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min), equilibrium about 760 ppm; record the decay towards it and fit C(t)=C_eq+(C0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau). Hatch held closed, same as step 1.

abort.when: CO2 at or above limits.co2AbortPpm (3000 ppm)
the device refuses a step's speed command
a monitored person leaves the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring is lost, or one more person is in the Lab

expected.rise: Under the hypotheses (V about 30 m3 as a first guess, 2 awake occupants at 0.38 L/min each = 0.76 L/min, Qe 0.4 m3/min at 40 percent, lag 3.33 min), the Lab CO2 rises from about 900 ppm towards about 1900 ppm with tau about 75 min, reaching about 1200 ppm at 30 min (rise of about 300 ppm), staying far below 2500 ppm.
expected.decay: At full speed the CO2 falls from about 1200 ppm towards C_eq about 760 ppm with tau = V/Qe about 30 min; about 930 ppm after 28 min. Ignore the first ~10 min (3 lag constants) after each speed change in the fit.
expected.result: V_lab = Qe * tau with Qe = 1 m3/min at full speed (datasheet); expected about 30 m3 (fitted range 10 to 200 m3).
expected.hypothesisFailsIf: A fitted tau of the two phases giving inconsistent V, a fitted C_eq far from G/Qe (about 760 ppm at full), a residual that is not exponential, or CO2 in Hab-B (co2-2-t4) moving with the Lab's, shows the one-zone or closed-hatch hypothesis does not hold (leak or mixing through the hatch), or that the occupants' activity changed.

hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone.

The exchange of air through the closed hatch (hatch-1-t4) to Hab-B is not measured and is not assumed zero; Hab-B CO2 (co2-2-t4) is recorded to reveal it (design inter-module ventilation with hatch closed is 3 m3/min per station-topology).
The occupants' CO2 production is constant (2 awake persons, 0.38 L/min each, range 0.26-0.45) and their number does not change; the crew are not measured, so the equilibrium is not used to infer V.
Effective scrubber flow is the datasheet value 1 m3/min at full speed and scales linearly with speed; the lag (3.33 min) is handled by excluding the first minutes after a step.
The first guess V = 30 m3 is only used to size durations, not as a result.
Records: Lab CO2 every minute, Hab-B CO2 every minute, scrubber speed commands and acceptance.
